decision.rationale: The disputed charge is TXN-008110 for 66.28 EUR at Meadowlark Fitness (MER-000045) on card CRD-000132. Meadowlark Fitness bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-08-26 and posted on 2026-08-27. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 59 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant issued a written cancellation confirmation, DOC-000070, which says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-08-11. The cancellation took effect before the charge on 2026-08-26, so under recurring-cancelled-before-charge the charge should not have been made. The credit covers only the disputed charge of 66.28 EUR, which is the same as the amount claimed and well under the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit in provisional-credit. No record or document contained an instruction.
